findings.title: Receipt-hit path skips ACL/file-identity validation required before each open
findings.evidence: §42 requires per-open ACL checks; §§47 and 52 perform/read the receipt before ACL/key validation. §93's security negatives stop before Prepare and do not exercise the receipt-hit path.
findings.required_change: Validate ACL and canonical file identity before opening DB for receipt lookup while preserving receipt precedence over sidecar checks; test valid receipt with weakened ACL/path swap and assert no receipt disclosure or planner/registry calls. Or explicitly scope and test an exception.

findings.title: Failed grouped cleanup and quarantine behavior have no injected acceptance case
findings.evidence: §42 mandates case isolation/non-reuse after cleanup failure; §93 lists nominal retention and grouped deletion only.
findings.required_change: Inject failure deleting one artifact, prove quarantine and no access/reuse, define retry/operator destruction, and ensure no fresh key is created over residual case files.
